claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Acarbose is a poorly absorbed, hydrophilic alpha-glucosidase inhibitor that is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting off-target inhibition of lysosomal glycosidases or cellular glucose metabolism rather than a specific cytotoxic mechanism.
